title: UL-10 — Challenge: Queue and event path
scenario: Add DLQ and idempotent Lambda handling to the messaging lab.
acceptanceCriteria: Primary SQS queue and dead-letter queue pair configured with redrive policy.
Lambda processes messages idempotently (duplicate delivery does not double side effects).
Failed messages land in DLQ after maxReceiveCount.
You send one bad message and observe DLQ depth increase.
CloudWatch log group for Lambda exists during test.
SNS topic fans out to queue and/or Lambda as designed.
IAM roles least privilege per service.
Teardown deletes event source mappings first.
Teardown deletes Lambda then log group.
DLQ is empty or deleted with queue.

hints.text: Use partial batch responses for SQS triggers.
Idempotency key in DynamoDB or conditional write.

stopChargesPanel: Delete mappings, Lambda, logs, DLQ, main queue, SNS for ul-10.

orderedDeletesPowerShell: aws sns list-subscriptions-by-topic --topic-arn $TopicArn --query Subscriptions[].SubscriptionArn --output text | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -and $_ -ne 'PendingConfirmation') { aws sns unsubscribe --subscription-arn $_ } }
verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-10 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-10 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=ul-10 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-10. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

beforeYouStart: Read the paired guided lab (gl-10) stop-charges panel before you create anything.
Set $env:AWS_PROFILE and $env:AWS_REGION. Do not use the root user.
